bit_order: bit 0 is payload coordinate 1; bit 8 is coordinate 9 parity; serialize to a UInt16 with only the low nine bits used

payload_bits.name: orientation_low
payload_bits.definition: Low bit of the nearest unoriented edge-tangent sector. Sector encoding: 0=horizontal tangent, 1=positive diagonal tangent, 2=vertical tangent, 3=negative diagonal tangent. Force sector 0 when edge_present is false.

payload_bits.name: orientation_high
payload_bits.definition: High bit of the same four-sector edge-tangent code.

payload_bits.name: edge_present
payload_bits.definition: Hysteretic threshold of contrast-normalized structure-tensor magnitude.

payload_bits.name: coherent_structure
payload_bits.definition: Hysteretic threshold of structure-tensor coherence; distinguishes line/edge-like support from isotropic/corner-like support.

payload_bits.name: texture_high_frequency
payload_bits.definition: Hysteretic threshold of normalized high-pass residual energy.

payload_bits.name: alias_or_ringing_risk
payload_bits.definition: Hysteretic threshold of a normalized Laplacian/gradient and alternating-gradient risk proxy. This is a versioned image-domain proxy, not a mathematical property of the ASH core.

payload_bits.name: temporal_support_valid
payload_bits.definition: True only when deterministic motion correspondence passes residual, forward/backward consistency, occlusion, and scene-cut gates. Always false in spatial-only phase.

payload_bits.name: chroma_luma_structure_aligned
payload_bits.definition: True when no significant chroma edge exists or when significant luma and chroma edge orientations agree under the locked angular and confidence thresholds.

integrity_bit.name: parity
integrity_bit.formula: b8 = b0 xor b1 xor b2 xor b3 xor b4 xor b5 xor b6 xor b7

structure_tensor.window: separable 5-tap binomial [1,4,6,4,1]/16 over gx^2, gy^2, gx*gy
structure_tensor.normal_orientation: theta_n = 0.5 * atan2(2*Jxy, Jxx-Jyy), normalized modulo pi; this is the dominant gradient/edge-normal orientation.
structure_tensor.tangent_orientation: theta_t = (theta_n + pi/2) modulo pi; use theta_t for edge-aligned support and orientation bits.
structure_tensor.sector_quantization: sector = floor((theta_t + pi/8)/(pi/4)) modulo 4; ties use the lower integer sector after fixed-point conversion.

feature_math.contrast_normalization: gradient magnitude divided by local RMS contrast plus epsilon
feature_math.risk_proxy: weighted combination of normalized absolute Laplacian energy and alternating first-difference energy along the dominant normal; weights and thresholds are calibration parameters
feature_math.chroma_alignment: max(0, cos(2*(theta_y-theta_c))) multiplied by the smaller edge confidence; if chroma edge confidence is below threshold, treat alignment as not contradicted
feature_math.numeric_epsilon: A versioned positive epsilon stored in the locked mapping. CPU and Metal must use the same encoded value.

hysteresis.rule: When previous motion-aligned state is valid, retain 1 until measurement falls below low threshold and retain 0 until measurement rises above high threshold. Without valid history, use midpoint (low+high)/2.
hysteresis.lock_requirement: Every null must be populated by deterministic development-corpus calibration and written to a signed/hash-locked mapping file before holdout evaluation.

calibration.method: Deterministic grid or coordinate search over predeclared ranges; no neural training and no runtime learning.
calibration.data_separation: Tune on development assets, choose configuration on validation assets, evaluate holdout once. Assets, not frames, are the split unit.
calibration.holdout_rule: After holdout metrics are viewed, that holdout becomes validation data for any subsequent mapping version; create and hash-lock a new holdout before the next claim.

required_tests: All 512 raw states have deterministic parity-valid/invalid classification.
All 256 valid states serialize identically in production Swift and independent reference-oracle.
Controlled fixtures toggle each payload bit without unintentionally toggling unrelated bits, except orientation pair changes by design.
State occupancy, transition, and hysteresis telemetry is emitted.
The production mapping version and hash are embedded in telemetry and sidecar provenance.

analysis_grid.reference: one state sample per source-lattice site using a bounded neighborhood
analysis_grid.lock_rule: Benchmark the candidates on development/validation for quality, state occupancy, churn, GPU time, and memory. Lock one per route before holdout; do not choose by intuition.
analysis_grid.dispatch_granularity: Decode and form compact dispatch records once per analysis cell and target phase; reconstruction taps consume the compact record and do not rerun feature extraction or branch compilation.
